coverImageAlt: Wooden structural frame with measured navy beams, a cyan joinery jig, and an orange locking wedge.
coverImagePrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: AI.Tedt.org artifact gallery cover
Artifact kind: Prompt Template File
Primary request: an architectural joinery bench where measurable business needs become precisely cut beams that lock into a dependable frame
Scene/backdrop: quiet warm-paper craft studio with a deep slate wall and open breathing room
Subject: one partially assembled timber frame, a cyan measuring jig aligning two navy beams, and one orange locking wedge showing acceptance and fit
Style/medium: premium tactile editorial illustration with crafted wood, paper templates, and dimensional model-making detail
Composition/framing: exact 16:10 landscape; low three-quarter view; scale the complete timber frame down so its roof peak, beams, posts, and base are all fully visible with generous clear margin on every side; dominant frame silhouette centered; no essential detail in the outer 8%; legible at approximately 290-pixel card width
Lighting/mood: deliberate, practical, trustworthy, restrained side light
Color palette: warm paper #F8F6F0, slate #101820, navy #00446F, cyan #00A9E0, sparing orange #E86027
Materials/textures: pale wood grain, matte painted beams, linen paper, metal-free measuring jig, soft workshop dust
Constraints: measuring surfaces completely blank with no tick marks; original composition; no text, pseudo-writing, letters, numbers, product UI, vendor logos, trademarks, watermarks, paws, paw imagery, paw logos, cats, cat silhouettes, or Microsoft Fluent styling
Avoid: generic blueprints, generic chatbot imagery, glowing brains, screens, dashboards, office people, construction logos, clutter
